content_md:
One thing that kept me from reading and writing in the last days was building a mobile-first Obsidian plugin to serve as local endpoint for [github.com/blygger/blyg…](https://github.com/blygger/blygger-studio), the reference client to take a seat in [Venkatesh Rao](https://substack.com/profile/2264734-venkatesh-rao)’s shiny speedboat that masters this ocean of drowning social media platforms: [blygger.org](https://blygger.org/) 🎉

I probably could have written 1-2 essays in the same time, but building this was arguably more fun and it somehow felt necessary, in the way sometimes you have first make paper and craft a pencil to start writing.

I will clean this up a bit and then share it as MIT public repo. If anyone is interested in soonish access, please get in touch :)
